subject: Marketplace SKU matrix by cloud + co-sell fallback heuristics
messages:
From: AcmeCorp Procurement <procurement@acmecorp.com>

Cc: Azure Partnership <azure-partner-team@microsoft.com>, GCP Channel Ops <gcp-channel@google.com>
Date: Sun, 01 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SKU coverage + co-sell path for multi-cloud pilot

Hi Karthik,

We're running a pilot to standardize LLM-powered features across our web and mobile products and need clarity on marketplace options. Specifically: 
- Which Redwood SKUs (predefined sku bundles / reserved capacity) are you planning to list on AWS, Azure, and GCP marketplaces?
- Are there recommended region defaults for each cloud (we're US-first, some EU capability later)?
- For co-sell eligibility, what artifacts do your partner teams need from us (revenue commitments, customer references, security checklist)?

Attached is our internal requirement doc (acmecorp_req_20261101.pdf). Can we sync early next week?

Thanks,
Jared Wilson
Procurement Manager, AcmeCorp

--

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SKU coverage + co-sell path for multi-cloud pilot

Team — forwarding Acme's ask. I'll own the listing matrix but need quick alignment on: default SKU shapes per cloud, region gating, and fallback behavior when a cloud listing is not yet live.

Proposal (initial):
- Offer 3 SKU families: Developer (low tokens), Production (reserved qps + moderate tokens), Dedicated (reserved capacity + SLA).
- AWS: list Developer + Production in us-east-1/us-west-2; Dedicated via AWS Marketplace Private Offers (partner contract).
- Azure: Developer + Production in East US; Dedicated requires Marketplace listing + co-sell registration (we'll need Azure partner artifacts).
- GCP: Developer only initially in us-central1; Production to follow after quoting process.

I've attached a draft SKU matrix (sku_matrix_v3.xlsx) and a short co-sell fallback playbook. Please review and add comments inline.

Karthik
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference

--
Attachments: sku_matrix_v3.xlsx (Excel, 85KB); co-sell_fallback_playbook_v1.pdf (PDF, 320KB)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>

Date: Wed, 04 Nov 2026 09:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SKU coverage + co-sell path for multi-cloud pilot

Karthik — looked through the matrix. A few pragmatic edits from ops/infra POV: 
1) Region gating: default to single-region GA (us-east-1) per cloud for Developer/Production — reduces support surface. Offer optional region expansion as a paid add-on in the Dedicated SKU.
2) Fallback heuristic: when Production listing missing on a cloud, route traffic to our hosted Redwood API (same SKU semantics) in nearest region; mark billing as 'cross-cloud fallback' for accounting.
3) Dedicated SKU: require minimum 3-month commit for Marketplace Private Offers; otherwise route to Dedicated on-host enroll flow.

I'll inline comments in sku_matrix_v3.xlsx and flag pricing deltas.

-Ben
Director, Platform Operations

Thanks everyone — consolidation below and next steps.

Decisions:
- SKU families: Developer / Production / Dedicated (final).
- Cloud coverage: AWS (Developer+Production in us-east-1; Dedicated via Private Offer), Azure (Developer+Production East US; Dedicated via Marketplace + co-sell registration), GCP (Developer us-central1 initially; Production after co-sell onboarding).
- Region policy: single-region GA; region expansion as paid add-on for Production and Dedicated.
- Fallback: implement automatic routing to Redwood-hosted endpoint with a "cross-cloud-fallback" billing flag. Engineering ticket INF-2243 will track rollout.

Action items (owners):
- Marissa: finalize SKU descriptions and publish sku_matrix_v3.xlsx to the Drive folder by EOD Wed (owner: marissa_cole).
- Ben: add fallback routing and metric flags to INF-2243; estimate ETA for staging test by Nov 24 (owner: ben_carter).
- Karthik: prepare partner artifact bundle for Azure/GCP and coordinate co-sell kickoff calls (owner: karthik_iyer).
- Me (Soojin): coordinate with Azure/GCP partner contacts to confirm co-sell checklist and confirm AcmeCorp's eligibility (owner: soojin_lee).

AcmeCorp — from your side, please confirm which environments you need regionally and whether you can provide a reference contact for co-sell registration. Happy to set a short sync with Azure/GCP partner teams this week.

Thanks,
Soojin Lee
Head of Channel Partnerships, Redwood Inference
